The '''Renadala Estate''' was a wealthy [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] estate on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. By [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], the estate had foreclosed.

For a time, until its foreclosure, [[Kitster Chanchani Banai|Kitster Banai]] was employed as its [[Majordomo/Legends|majordomo]].
